description.value: Kelowna Memorial Arena is a public sports facility in Kelowna, BC, primarily associated with lacrosse. As a City of Kelowna recreation facility, it serves the local community and may offer amenities typical of municipal arenas. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna may find it a useful landmark or rest stop depending on events and access.
